main.description: Per-actor credit balance for the ameno Tier 2 (browser) reward loop. Backed by mv_ameno_credits_balance which aggregates vertex_credits_af_event rows (event_type='ameno_browser_inference') written by saveResult. Read goes via CF Worker XRPC → bpmn-dispatcher → ameno-langserver pod SELECT (ADR-2605111200).

actorDid.description: Actor DID to query (matches vertex_credits_af_event.user_id). 'anon' is a valid value for unauthenticated browser tabs.

balance.description: Cumulative credit total earned from browser inference (zero if no events yet).
